title: Oura Readiness Score Drop Alert
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), Whoop recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings measurements (`withings:measure`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export or Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, Whoop, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:daily
| timechart span=1d avg(readiness_score) as readiness
| streamstats window=7 current=f avg(readiness) as week_avg
| eval drop=round(week_avg-readiness,1)
| where drop>10
description: Compares today's Oura readiness score to your recent seven-day average and flags a sharp drop, signalling your body needs an easier day.
value: A readiness crash is a data-driven reason to skip a hard workout; acting on it prevents the deeper fatigue that leads to illness or injury.
implementation: Ingest Oura daily readiness; schedule each morning and send yourself a 'take it easy' nudge when readiness drops sharply.
visualization: Line chart of readiness with drop markers.
grandmaExplanation: It notices when your body's recovery score falls a lot overnight and suggests taking it easy that day.
